therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: partial agonist activity at α4β2 nicotinic receptors
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: reduction of nicotine craving and withdrawal symptoms
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: smokers in recovery from alcohol dependence
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: biochemically confirmed 7-day point prevalence smoking abstinence at week 12

results.effect_size: 10 participants achieved abstinence out of 32 enrolled (31.3%)

dose_info.schedule: 0.5 mg once daily days 1-3, then 0.5 mg twice daily days 4-7, then 1 mg twice daily weeks 2-12

context.indication: tobacco abstinence in smokers with alcohol dependence recovery
